name: me.chippynear/fish-and-chips
title: Fish and Chips by chippynear.me
description: Find chip shops near you, with opening hours, prices and reviews from chippynear.me.

tools.name: chippy_dilemma
tools.description: Light-hearted: the Dilemma Court rules on a chip shop counter dilemma, and the server picks the verdict. Use only when the user can't decide one of these chip shop dilemmas: pickled_egg, scraps, peas_or_curry, battered_sausage, chip_size, salt_and_vinegar, gravy, extra_for_the_dog, eat_on_the_way, salt_and_sauce. For finding a chip shop use find_fish_and_chips. If a location is known (lat/lng, or the user's configured default location), the result includes the nearest chippy. Returns a verdict and a brief: follow the brief and announce the verdict exactly.

dilemma.description: The dilemma: one of pickled_egg, scraps, peas_or_curry, battered_sausage, chip_size, salt_and_vinegar, gravy, extra_for_the_dog, eat_on_the_way, salt_and_sauce.

wait_minutes.description: How many minutes the user has been waiting at the counter, if they said.

times_this_week.description: How many chippy teas the user has already had this week, if they said.

sharing_with.description: Who is sharing the car or sofa with the user afterwards, if they said, e.g. "my partner" or "the kids".

lat.description: Latitude of where the user is, to name the nearest chippy. Supply together with lng.

lng.description: Longitude of where the user is, to name the nearest chippy. Supply together with lat.

tools.name: chippy_tea_excuse
tools.description: Light-hearted: write funny excuses for having fish and chips (a chippy tea) again. Use only when the user wants an excuse or justification for fish and chips; for finding a chip shop use find_fish_and_chips. If a location is known (lat/lng, or the user's configured default location), the result includes the nearest chippy: open now if possible, otherwise one whose hours are unknown. Returns a brief: follow it.

times_this_week.description: How many chippy teas the user has already had this week, if they said.

justifying_to.description: Who the excuse has to convince, e.g. "my partner", "my doctor", "the dog" or "myself".

lat.description: Latitude of where the user is, to find the nearest chippy. Supply together with lng.

lng.description: Longitude of where the user is, to find the nearest chippy. Supply together with lat.

tools.name: find_fish_and_chips
tools.description: Find fish and chip shops (chippies) near a location, nearest first. When the user names a place, town, landmark or postcode, convert it to approximate latitude/longitude yourself and pass lat and lng. Use query only to match text in a shop's name or address. With no lat/lng or query, the user's configured default location is used if they set one; otherwise ask the user where they are. Set open_now to only show shops known to be open right now. If a shop has a note, mention it to the user. Links to batteredeconomy.com go to chippynear.me's sister site, which shares its listings.

lat.description: Latitude of the place to search near, e.g. 51.296. Supply together with lng.

lng.description: Longitude of the place to search near, e.g. -0.331. Supply together with lat.

query.description: Optional text that must appear in a shop's name, address or town, e.g. "codfather".

open_now.description: Only return shops known to be open right now.

limit.description: Maximum number of shops to return: default 5, at most 20.

tools.name: get_chippy
tools.description: Get details for one fish and chip shop found by find_fish_and_chips: opening hours, phone, prices visitors reported, recent reviews, its price compared with the national average, and map directions links from the user's current location (use get_directions to start from somewhere else). If the shop has a note, mention it to the user. Links to batteredeconomy.com go to chippynear.me's sister site, which shares its listings.

id.description: The shop's id, or its chippynear.me link, from find_fish_and_chips.

tools.name: get_directions
tools.description: Get map links (Google Maps and Apple Maps) for getting to one chip shop found by find_fish_and_chips, walking, cycling, driving or by public transport. Use fromCurrentLocation when the user is setting off now; use fromGivenLocation when they're planning a trip from somewhere else.

id.description: The shop's id, or its chippynear.me link, from find_fish_and_chips.

mode.description: Only this way of travelling: walking, cycling, driving or transit. Leave out for all.

lat.description: Latitude to start from, e.g. 54.486, when the user is starting somewhere else. Supply together with lng.

lng.description: Longitude to start from, e.g. -0.615. Supply together with lat.

tools.name: pun_inspector
tools.description: Light-hearted: rate the names of chip shops near a place for pun quality, as a stern Pun Inspector. Use only when the user asks to rate, judge or roast chippy names or puns; for finding a chip shop use find_fish_and_chips. Convert a named place to approximate latitude/longitude yourself and pass lat and lng. With no lat/lng, the user's configured default location is used if they set one; otherwise ask the user where. Returns up to 20 nearby shops and a brief: follow the brief and rate only those shops.

lat.description: Latitude of the place to inspect, e.g. 54.486. Supply together with lng.

lng.description: Longitude of the place to inspect, e.g. -0.615. Supply together with lat.
